::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}

The algebra notes are split across these pages:

- [Equalities, Inequalities and Minimizers](algebra-basics.qmd):
  equalities, inequalities, powers, square roots and absolute values,
  minima and maxima, and global and local minimizers.
- [Convexity, Infimum and Sums](algebra-sums.qmd):
  convex functions, the infimum and supremum,
  sums, products and quotients, and summation notation.
- [Polynomials, Exponentials and Logarithms](algebra-exponentials.qmd):
  polynomials, affine and linear functions of one variable,
  limits of sequences, exponentials and logarithms.
- [Complex Numbers](algebra-complex.qmd):
  complex numbers and their arithmetic.

A link to a section, theorem or definition on this page from before the split
goes on to the page that now holds it.

## Further reading {#sec-further-reading}

- @abramson2021algebra
  is a free online textbook on algebra and trigonometry.
  It covers equations, inequalities, polynomials, exponentials, and logarithms,
  which overlap with the algebra in these notes.
- @rudin1976principles
  develops the real numbers, including the least upper bound property
  behind the infimum and supremum.
